I'm a sophomore at Pomona College studying Mathematics on the Statistics track, with a minor in Data Science. Through my coursework, I've become fascinated by how statistics and data science can be used to uncover patterns, make predictions, and understand risk. This interest has drawn me towards a career as an actuary, where I hope to bring together my interests in statistics, data science, and risk analysis.

This site is where I'll share the projects, research, and experiences that are shaping my growth as a statistician and data scientist, along with the questions I'm exploring along the way.
